title.zh-CN: 两次 LLM 抽取结果对比

description.en: Two runs of an LLM entity/relation extractor over the same short article on Marie Curie. Ids are random per run, so nodes are aligned by similarity: label variants (“Marie Curie” / “Marie Skłodowska-Curie”, “polonium (Po)” / “Polonium”), a hallucinated entity, two entities only the second run found, a few changed relations and one ambiguous pair left as a suggestion.
description.zh-CN: 同一篇居里夫人短文的两次 LLM 实体 / 关系抽取结果。两次运行的 id 随机生成，因此按相似度对齐节点：标签变体（“Marie Curie” / “Marie Skłodowska-Curie”、“polonium (Po)” / “Polonium”）、一次幻觉实体、只有第二次抽到的两个实体、若干关系变化，以及一对留作建议的歧义节点。
